candidate_claim: A public biological reference can support risk ranking without target risk-training errors.
evaluation_scope: McFaline 543 tasks / 380 genes; common2840; seen
qualification: Information package includes support and precision; support-only is 0.827129. Upstream validation calibration used target outcomes.
unsupported_extension: Do not claim all gain comes from biological content or the full pipeline uses no target outcomes.

candidate_claim: Source supervision improves on same-reference weighted distance within the mature architecture pair.
evaluation_scope: Source 1808 tasks / 575 genes; two architectures one family
qualification: Older mixed-context Source matrix remains DEV/SEEN. New risk follow-up uses context-specific teachers and source errors; shared Public gene folds do not recertify old results.
unsupported_extension: Not independent-family or cross-study confirmation.

candidate_claim: Shared HGB is superior to the strongest simple Source rule.
evaluation_scope: Same Source tasks
qualification: Fixed fitted models; nominal gene-cluster uncertainty.
unsupported_extension: No established superiority over magnitude.

candidate_claim: Source error labels contain information beyond the biological effect RMS proxy.
evaluation_scope: Same Source pair; ten new fits and ten reused
qualification: One biological difficulty proxy; neither causal identification nor family generalization.
unsupported_extension: No claim that all task-difficulty alternatives are ruled out.

candidate_claim: Source error mapping transfers better than public distance across research datasets.
evaluation_scope: McFaline and Orion evaluated separately
qualification: Different axes/cohorts; Orion primary safety check failed.
unsupported_extension: No universal cross-study benefit or successful Orion main confirmation.

candidate_claim: Public support itself carries substantial risk information in McFaline.
evaluation_scope: McFaline 543 tasks / 380 genes
qualification: Association can involve sampling precision and study construction.
unsupported_extension: Do not call cell count experimental quality or a causal explanation.

candidate_claim: Orion provides a fixed prospective check of the original shared model.
evaluation_scope: 2993 tasks / 1750 genes total; 232 / 144 supported
qualification: HCT116 risk-safety measures fail; later diagnostics are seen.
unsupported_extension: Cannot promote a secondary winner or use this as confirmation of PublicSet.

candidate_claim: Target feedback is useful when combined with public features.
evaluation_scope: McFaline 212 tasks / 152 genes; budget-specific CDF
actual_evidence: Full-budget PublicTarget HGB=0.774747 vs Shared=0.571055; TargetOnly HGB=0.083253
qualification: No-feedback support comparator remains strong; curves nonmonotonic.
unsupported_extension: No general low-feedback benefit or guaranteed monotonic improvement.

candidate_claim: A shared risk score adds benefit to public features after target feedback.
evaluation_scope: Same feedback splits and labels
qualification: Point difference is not an equivalence claim.
unsupported_extension: Do not require two residual corrections in the deployed method.

candidate_claim: PertEMA is a fair fixed learner comparator under adapted same-information conditions.
evaluation_scope: Same feedback budget; official factory commit pinned
qualification: Features/target/weights changed; no allocated conformal set.
unsupported_extension: No full-original-pipeline reproduction or superiority claim from these points alone.

candidate_claim: Refitting the public learner improves subsequent risk performance.
evaluation_scope: Source DEV old-anchor and new-gate tasks
actual_evidence: Biological RMSE improves slightly; new-task U20 candidate-old=-0.014099; release rejected
qualification: The registered candidate release was rejected and the old serving version retained; no future-task neural update benefit is claimed.
unsupported_extension: No proof that increasing memory always improves risk.

candidate_claim: PublicSet learns useful history interactions beyond per-record models.
evaluation_scope: Source 1808/575 and McFaline 542/377; five folds and three neural seeds; DEV/SEEN
actual_evidence: B3-B2 U20 GAT +0.001955; Exphormer -0.006652; McFaline -0.005082; every structure gate fails
qualification: Fixed historical-reader decision; supervised joint reader is evaluated separately. Source pointwise gains versus B1 do not establish superiority over magnitude.
unsupported_extension: No new general set operator or supported collection-interaction gain; no conclusion about untested builder-reader combinations.

candidate_claim: Public evidence supports risk ranking across the scGPT/GEARS pair on native512 stress data.
evaluation_scope: Frangieh 567 tasks / 189 genes; history-matched 471 tasks; native512
actual_evidence: PublicHGB 0.701422/0.740099; weighted-distance paired delta -0.058246/-0.123904; all six competence gates fail
qualification: Existing upstream test reused as seen risk development; three upstream folds overlap; all upstream validation relative gaps 8.13-14.10%.
unsupported_extension: No fresh confirmation or qualified cross-family main-method validation.

candidate_claim: Biological reconstruction improvement necessarily improves risk ranking.
evaluation_scope: Reference-reader distinction
actual_evidence: Completed refit improves reconstruction but not risk; fixed readout diagnostic retained
qualification: Reconstruction objective and risk objective differ.
unsupported_extension: Do not promote a builder based only on biological RMSE.

candidate_claim: A monotonic output repair removes the Ridge clipping defect but establishes useful source transfer.
evaluation_scope: Frangieh native512 retrospective seen; identical tasks; no refit
actual_evidence: scGPT-to-GEARS heldout PublicRidge U20 -0.056218 to 0.099943; below Magnitude 0.378869; repaired PublicRidge minus weighted history -0.060769 / -0.744538
qualification: One prespecified monotonic map; original 120 fitted models and primary results protected; six competence gates fail.
unsupported_extension: No percentile calibration; no qualification upgrade; no repair search or independent confirmation.

candidate_claim: Changing within-experiment historical-effect weighting improves the fixed public-distance rule.
evaluation_scope: McFaline 543 tasks / 380 genes; common2840; seen post-confirmation
actual_evidence: Cell-weighted U20 0.834314 vs equal-guide 0.711295; paired difference 0.123019 [0.056150,0.198610]; versus support difference 0.007185 interval includes zero
qualification: Same predictions/query truth/eligibility/history weights; 7173 train-val public experiments; zero test cells aggregated.
unsupported_extension: No neural architecture gain; no superiority over support; no fresh confirmation.

candidate_claim: Aligned public inputs automatically improve an existing source risk reader.
evaluation_scope: Same McFaline seen diagnostic; one source HGB replay fit
actual_evidence: CellAlignedManualHGB U20 0.575302 vs replay 0.648814; difference CI [-0.185328,0.108838]; versus aligned historical rule -0.259012 [-0.371281,-0.127813]
qualification: No new target risk-training labels; original replay score reproduced; reader relationship can shift with reference change.
unsupported_extension: Do not transfer the direct-rule alignment gain to the learned reader.

candidate_claim: Pointwise weighting improves Source historical ranking over the existing HGB reference.
evaluation_scope: Source two upstream views; 1808 tasks/575 genes; DEV/SEEN
qualification: Both Source pairwise practical gates pass, but magnitude remains stronger and cross-domain replacement gate fails.
unsupported_extension: No global adoption or independent confirmation.

candidate_claim: Matched same-context aggregation is a strong McFaline reference comparator.
evaluation_scope: McFaline 542 tasks/377 genes; five folds; DEV/SEEN
actual_evidence: Same-context U20 0.872175; B2/B3 0.869870/0.864788; paired intervals include zero
qualification: Matching fixed before metrics; support fallback uses all histories when no match exists.
unsupported_extension: No statistically established superiority or universal context-matching rule.

candidate_claim: Cell-weighted effect alignment contributes more to McFaline fixed-reader gain than the tested neural increment.
evaluation_scope: McFaline 542 tasks/377 genes; fold macro DEV/SEEN
qualification: Comparison holds query truth and within-run folds fixed; 543-task older diagnostic retained separately.
unsupported_extension: No transfer of alignment gain to architecture or source supervision.
